summary: Verified all 4 new features (Owner Statement Year Filter, Email Statement gated modal, Balance column on Units, Delinquency Report) plus regressions (This-Month tile, Bank Reconcile, Annual Report CSV exports). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend: all data-testid selectors present and behave per spec.

backend.GET /api/units/balances: 200 OK, shape { unit_id: {overdue, months_overdue, balance_due} }. Note: 'overdue' is returned as number (0.0/dollar amount) rather than bool — matches spec loosely.
backend.GET /api/units/{id}/ledger?year=2026: 200 OK, rows scoped to 2026, totals <= all-years totals.
backend.POST /api/units/{id}/statement/email: 428 as expected (Gmail send scope not granted).
backend.GET /api/reports/delinquency: 200 OK, shape {generated_at, rows: [], totals: {delinquent_units:0, total_overdue:0, grand_billed:51348.0, grand_collected:46404.0}}. Note: fields named grand_billed/grand_collected, not billed_all_time/collected_all_time — UI renders 'BILLED (ALL-TIME) $51,348.00' correctly.

frontend.login: OK — redirects to / (dashboard) not /dashboard. this-month-tile present.
frontend.units_balance_column: 10 unit-balance-* badges rendered; all currently 'Current' (green). Matches spec because all owners paid through July 2026.
frontend.unit_row_menu: unit-menu-* present; view-unit-* present and navigates to /units/:id (OwnerLedger).
frontend.owner_ledger_page: owner-ledger-page renders. ledger-year-select present with options [All years, 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023]. Default 'all'. Switching to 2026 changes summary text (totals recompute confirmed by text-diff).
frontend.email_statement_modal_gated: email-statement-btn opens email-statement-modal. email-needs-reconnect warning shown. send-statement-btn disabled=True. email-to-input prefilled with owner email (e.g. amroe42@yahoo.com). Matches spec exactly.
frontend.delinquency_page: /delinquency loads. nav-delinquency sidebar link present. Stat cards: Delinquent Units 0, Total Overdue $0.00, Billed (all-time) $51,348.00, Collected (all-time) $46,404.00. delinquency-empty 'No past-due balances. Every owner is current.' visible.
frontend.annual_report_exports_regression: /reports — data-exports card + export-fees-btn + export-expenses-btn + export-owner-summary-btn all present.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/units/balances 'overdue' field is a numeric amount (e.g. 0.0), not a boolean. The frontend badge logic appears to work correctly (Current vs X due) but a boolean flag would be clearer to consumers. Consider adding both is_overdue (bool) and overdue_amount (float).
Delinquency response uses keys grand_billed / grand_collected while the UI displays 'Billed (all-time)' / 'Collected (all-time)'. Naming inconsistency between API and UI copy — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BankReconcile route is /bank (not /bank-reconcile). Annual Report/Data Exports route is /reports (not /annual-report). Auth login endpoint returns 'access_token' key. Owner ledger route: /units/:unitId. Year select values: 'all' | '2026' | '2025' | '2024' | '2023'. Delinquency currently shows 0 past-due (data-testid delinquency-empty) because everyone paid through Jul 2026.
